caseName: F. & M. Schaefer Brewing Co. v. Gerosa
caseNameFull: F. & M. SCHAEFER BREWING CO. v. GEROSA, COMPTROLLER OF THE CITY OF NEW YORK
attorneys: Russell D. Morrill and Francis L. Casey for appellant., Stanley Buchsbaum and Morris L. Heath for appellee.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

The motion to dismiss is granted and the appeal is dismissed for want of a substantial federal question.

Mr. Justice Frankfurter took no part in the consideration or decision of this case.
